question:
Based on the given diagram, identify the type of jack depicted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6e757587d51d6cd1fbfd7aa0d6058bb13f82d6a211e3a0eb69d38dc10544045.png]

options.text: Light weight screw jack (manual type lifting jack)
Heavy duty bottle type hydraulic jack

solution:
The correct answer is __Light weight screw jack (manual type lifting jack)__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Light weight screw jack__ is a manual type lifting jack.
 
• It is used to lift light loads such as small vehicles during maintenance or tire changes.
 
• Operates on a mechanical screw principle, requiring manual effort to raise or lower the load.
 
• It is portable, compact, and easy to use.
 
• Not suitable for heavy-duty applications where hydraulic jacks are preferred.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Axle Stand:**
 
 
• Used to support the weight of a vehicle after it has been lifted by a jack.
 
• Does not lift the vehicle but holds it securely in place.
 
 
 
• **Heavy Duty Bottle Type Hydraulic Jack:**
 
 
• Uses hydraulic fluid to lift heavy loads with minimal effort.
 
• Commonly used for trucks and heavy vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Trolley Type Hydraulic Jack:**
 
 
• Features wheels for easy movement and positioning under vehicles.
 
• Designed for stability and suitable for garage or workshop use.
